article.title: BT Live: US midterm elections show
article.author: Zoe.
article.content: The Democratic Party won big on Tuesday, November 3, winning a majority in both the House of Representatives and the Senate, and unseating Republicans in historically red states. BreakThrough News hosted a special midterm elections show with Rania Khalek and Zoe Alexandra bringing you the results as they came in and discussing critical issues shaping the election, including the war on Iran, Palestine, data centers, ICE, healthcare, labor struggles, and so much more. Special Guests included: Jamaal Bowman, former Congressional Representative Trita Parsi, Executive Vice President of the Quincy Institute Katie Halper, Host of The Katie Halper Show John Russell, Emmy-award winning labor journalist and author of The Holler Newsletter Claudia de la Cruz, former presidential candidate Erik Sperling, Executive Director of Just Foreign Policy Andre Easton, Teacher and Congressional candidate challenging Ritichie Torres Amanda Yee, Host of The China Report on BreakThrough News Ben Becker, Editor-in-Chief of BreakThrough News
